subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw define a new core session process-event contract, or keep existing agent/session/tool streams as the supported progress source of truth?
rationale: This request creates a cross-cutting public event/API contract with security and replay semantics, so automation should not pick the taxonomy, persistence model, or observer boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design a core process stream
options.body: Define a stable `process.*` / `step.*` API with ordering, persistence or replay limits, authorization, redaction, and mappings from existing event streams before implementation.

options.title: Use existing streams only
options.body: Keep the current `agent`, `session.tool`, and SDK run-event surfaces and narrow the issue to client-side mapping or documentation gaps.

options.title: Defer to narrower consumers
options.body: Treat related UI, inter-session, and CLI-streaming issues as separate consumers and revisit a shared process contract after one concrete path is designed.

recommendation.title: Design a core process stream
recommendation.body: Define a stable `process.*` / `step.*` API with ordering, persistence or replay limits, authorization, redaction, and mappings from existing event streams before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears most connected to gateway event/API direction and adjacent progress surfaces in recent history.
